# Hermes Agent Helm documentation

> Machine-readable map of the published documentation.

## Core guides

- [Install](https://jyje.github.io/hermes-agent-helm/getting-started/install/): Install and verify Hermes Agent.
- [Examples](https://jyje.github.io/hermes-agent-helm/examples/): Choose a ready-made values overlay.
- [Configuration](https://jyje.github.io/hermes-agent-helm/guides/configuration/): Configuration precedence and persistence.
- [Chart reference](https://jyje.github.io/hermes-agent-helm/reference/chart-readme/): Full maintained chart README and values table.

## Values examples

- [OpenAI](https://jyje.github.io/hermes-agent-helm/examples/providers/openai/): A minimal configuration for getting started with the OpenAI API.
- [Anthropic](https://jyje.github.io/hermes-agent-helm/examples/providers/anthropic/): Configure Claude as the default model provider.
- [Google Gemini](https://jyje.github.io/hermes-agent-helm/examples/providers/gemini/): Use the Google AI Studio Gemini API.
- [Google Vertex AI](https://jyje.github.io/hermes-agent-helm/examples/providers/google-vertex/): Connect to Vertex AI Gemini with a GCP service account.
- [GitHub Copilot](https://jyje.github.io/hermes-agent-helm/examples/providers/github-copilot/): Complete GitHub Copilot device login through Discord.
- [NVIDIA NIM + Discord](https://jyje.github.io/hermes-agent-helm/examples/providers/nvidia-nim-and-discord/): Connect NVIDIA NIM and a Discord bot in one release.
- [OpenRouter](https://jyje.github.io/hermes-agent-helm/examples/providers/openrouter/): Select upstream models with one OpenRouter key.
- [Fireworks AI](https://jyje.github.io/hermes-agent-helm/examples/providers/fireworks/): Use the Fireworks OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
- [DeepInfra](https://jyje.github.io/hermes-agent-helm/examples/providers/deepinfra/): Connect to the DeepInfra OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
- [Upstage Solar](https://jyje.github.io/hermes-agent-helm/examples/providers/upstage/): Use Upstage Solar as the model provider.
- [LiteLLM (external)](https://jyje.github.io/hermes-agent-helm/examples/integrations/litellm/): Connect to a network-reachable LiteLLM proxy.
- [LiteLLM (in cluster)](https://jyje.github.io/hermes-agent-helm/examples/integrations/litellm-k8s/): Connect to LiteLLM through an in-cluster Service.
- [Anthropic + Discord](https://jyje.github.io/hermes-agent-helm/examples/integrations/anthropic-and-discord/): Combine Claude and a Discord bot in one release.
- [OpenAI + Telegram](https://jyje.github.io/hermes-agent-helm/examples/integrations/openai-and-telegram/): Combine OpenAI and a Telegram bot in one release.
- [Dashboard Ingress](https://jyje.github.io/hermes-agent-helm/examples/integrations/ingress/): Expose the management dashboard behind an authenticated Ingress.
- [Bitwarden Secrets Manager](https://jyje.github.io/hermes-agent-helm/examples/advanced/bitwarden/): Fetch provider credentials from Bitwarden at startup.
- [Mixture of Agents](https://jyje.github.io/hermes-agent-helm/examples/advanced/moa/): Combine reference models with an aggregator model.
- [Collaborating pair](https://jyje.github.io/hermes-agent-helm/examples/advanced/multi-agent-collab/): Run a collaborating pair in the same Discord channel.
- [Shared knowledge PVC](https://jyje.github.io/hermes-agent-helm/examples/advanced/shared-knowledge/): Mount an RWX PVC as shared knowledge for multiple agents.
- [Team leader](https://jyje.github.io/hermes-agent-helm/examples/advanced/team-leader/): Run the leader of a Discord thread-based team.
- [Team member](https://jyje.github.io/hermes-agent-helm/examples/advanced/team-member/): Run an individual release in a leader-led team.
